This is the recipe to brew the Zombkolaps Potion. Depending on how you brew this potion, you can create either a drinkable or splash version of the Zombkolaps Potion.

Firstly, in a brewing stand make a Thick Potion using a water bottle and glowstone dust. Then, add rotten flesh to the potion to create the Zombkolaps potion. You can add gunpowder to turn into a splash potion.
